paper_sections.title: Conditional and syllogistic deductive tasks dissociate functionally during premise integration.
Neuroimaging Evidence on Encoding and Integration
Functional Homogeneity of the Syllogistic Network

description.value: The study compared brain activity during conditional and syllogistic deductive reasoning, separately examining premise encoding and premise integration in the same participants.

spans.text: We used event-related fMRI, in the same group of subjects, to compare reasoning-related activity associated with conditional and syllogistic deductive problems.
Furthermore, we assessed reasoning-related activity for the two main stages of deduction, namely encoding of premises and their integration.

design.value: Event-related fMRI study using a within-participants comparison of conditional and syllogistic deductive problems, with separate encoding and integration stages and memory trials as the encoding baseline.
